title: When the Playlist Turns
author: O. M. Voss
blurb: Coral Crane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
